journey.name: Start a workout
journey.description: Edit the next workout's work time, start it, pause and resume, skip ahead, then end it before any round is finished. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the Timer tab is shown with a "Start workout" button
Verify that a sheet titled "Work" is shown with "Quick picks"
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready" and a countdown clock
Verify that the screen shows "Paused" and a "Resume" button
Verify that the screen shows a "Pause" button
Verify that the screen shows "Work" and "Round 1 of 8"
Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" says nothing is saved
Verify that the Timer tab is shown with a "Start workout" button
